title: llm-stack-ts configuration
description: stack.toml (or stack.json). In TOML, add `#:schema /path/to/stack.schema.json` on the first line for editor completion.

vram_capacity_gb.description: Total VRAM available to gpu launchers. No budget check when omitted.

vars.description: Variables usable as ${name} in launcher strings (command, args, cwd, env, health.url...). A variable may use the ones defined before it.

oneOf.description: Legacy form: each launcher carries its name.
true renders a bare flag, false removes an inherited one.
Repeats the flag once per value.

extends.description: Inherit every setting from this launcher; args, env and health are merged key by key.

abstract.description: Only used as a parent: not listed and cannot be started. Not inherited.

kind.description: llama-server: command defaults to `llama-server`, --host/--port are added from host/port, the health url defaults to http://<host>:<port>/health and short flags (c, m, fa, np, ngl...) are normalized to their long names.

type.description: Free-form label, e.g. text-generation or image.

command.description: Run with bash as `exec <command> <args>`. Optional for kind = llama-server.

args.description: Options appended to command: `ctx-size = 16384` → --ctx-size 16384, single letters → -x, keys starting with - are kept as is.

exclusive.description: Starting this launcher stops every other running exclusive launcher. Defaults to the value of gpu.

process_match.description: Substring of the process command line, used to adopt a process started outside stack. Defaults to an exact match on the command line.

url.description: Required unless inherited or derived (kind = llama-server).

expected_status.description: Exact status to expect. Any 2xx is accepted when omitted.
